teach.goal: Ponte português → inglês com palavras úteis.
solo: Peça uma frase pessoal com 2 das palavras.
group: Palavras: stairs, hall, heavy, apologize, mover, view.
Aluno diz em português um uso real, depois a palavra em inglês.
extra90: Cada aluno escolhe a palavra mais útil e explica por quê.

facts.label: Preposição + gerúndio
facts.sub: Depois de preposição, use o verbo com -ing: thanks for helping, good at cooking, afraid of falling, interested in learning, by carrying. Nunca use to + verbo.

facts.label: Obrigado por
facts.sub: Use thanks for + -ing para agradecer uma ação: Thanks for helping me. Thanks for coming. Também diga thank you for waiting. Nunca use to + verbo depois de for.

facts.label: Bom em
facts.sub: Use good at + -ing para falar de talento: I’m good at lifting heavy things. She is good at cooking. O contrário é bad at.

pages.title: Moving day · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a rainy Saturday afternoon in a new building in Seattle. Boxes fill the hall in front of the door. Flo wipes her hands and looks tired. Her friend Theo carries the last heavy box. She says thanks for helping her. They talk about things they are good at and afraid of.

“Theo, thanks for helping me move the boxes into the hall.” says Flo. “You’re welcome. I’m good at lifting heavy things, but I’m afraid of falling on the stairs.” says Theo. “Sorry for asking you so late. I’m tired of waiting for the movers.” says Flo.
